1.consolidated_definition: Ático. Apartamento espacioso, con pocas divisiones, grandes ventanas y muy luminoso. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Experimenta las mejores vacaciones de tu vida en la mas hermosa capital caribeña: Viejo San Juan. Hermoso loft completamente amueblado y convenientemente ubicado en el corazon del Viejo San Juan. A solo pasos del mar, museos, restaurantes, pubs, bares, joyerias, tiendas artesanales (Pisos alquiler, San Juan, consultado 10-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Loft. Spacious apartment with few divisions, large windows and very bright. Anglicism, not commonly used. Experience the best vacations of your life in the most beautiful Caribbean capital: Old San Juan. Beautifully furnished loft conveniently located in the heart of Old San Juan. Just steps away from the sea, museums, restaurants, pubs, bars, jewelry stores, artisan shops (Loft rentals, San Juan, consulted 10-10-08)
